name: Find a Number
description: You are given two positive integers $$$d$$$ and $$$s$$$. Find minimal positive integer $$$n$$$ which is divisible by $$$d$$$ and has sum of digits equal to $$$s$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains two positive integers $$$d$$$ and $$$s$$$ ($$$1 \le d \le 500, 1 \le s \le 5000$$$) separated by space.
output_specification: Print the required number or -1 if it doesn't exist.
approach_summary: Express count as f(R) - f(L-1). Define memoized state dp[pos][tight][leading_zeros][cond] scanning digits from most to least significant in O(digits × base × states).
